conventions.source: staging/blender/2026-11-18_vfx/vfx_v2_combos.blend, scene Look, as saved on disk (2026-11-19). Visible set = objects with el=combo minus c2drop=1, plus el=combo2 (notes.md, Combos pass 2).
conventions.made: 2026-11-19 by Claude through the Blender MCP connection; transforms verified by rebuilding three combos from the kit FBX files (worst piece within 1.5 cm of the original).
conventions.axes: Unity axes, metres. Unity x = -Blender x, Unity y = Blender z (up), Unity z = -Blender y. Assumes the kit FBX files are imported with Bake Axis Conversion so each kit object's local axes are Unity axes.
conventions.origin: Every position is relative to the station origin: the main body's (enemy~<pair>) position projected to the ground (y = 0). Offsets are world-aligned (the combo camera looks along Unity +z, from -z, 55 degrees down), not in the body's yaw; the body's own rotation is listed under bodies.
conventions.groups: Pieces that share mesh, kit object, material and pass are grouped. Each instance is [object, position, rotation_euler_deg, scale, placement].
conventions.instance.object: The Blender object name. When it starts with '.' or is empty it is a suffix: full name = <mesh without suffix> + '~' + pair + suffix (for example vfx_fire_ember~fire_ice.013).
conventions.instance.rotation_euler_deg: Unity Euler angles in degrees (Quaternion.Euler(x, y, z), applied Z then X then Y); 0 means no rotation. Rounded to 1 degree.
conventions.instance.scale: A number for uniform scale, else [x, y, z] in Unity local axes. Rounded to 0.01.
conventions.instance.placement: g = on the ground (the piece's top is no higher than 0.15 m above the floor), b = on or around the body.
conventions.group.kit_object: The object name inside group.kit, the FBX that holds the mesh with its pivot at the base centre (pass-2 export convention). Names keep Blender's .001 suffixes where the FBX has them.
conventions.group.material: The material the piece wears in the render (pass-2 combos re-colour shared meshes per piece, so this can differ from the kit's default material).
conventions.group.pass: combo2 = built or placed in combos pass 2; combo = first-pass combo piece kept in pass 2.
conventions.lights: Point lights. colour_linear is linear RGB; intensity_blender_W is Blender's power in watts (EEVEE), not a Unity intensity; range_m is null when Blender uses no custom cutoff (EEVEE then derives the reach from power and its light threshold); radius_m is the soft-shadow radius. first_pass = a first-pass combo light kept in pass 2.
conventions.bodies: The enemy model (enemy_husk) and any after-image copies; not kit pieces.
conventions.timing: No combo has keyframes on any piece or light: every look is one held frame (static).
conventions.missing_from_kits: Meshes used by the combo that are in no vfx_<element>_kit_v2.fbx and not in vfx_combo_kit_v2.fbx. All of them are exported to vfx_combo_kit_v3.fbx (54 meshes, pass-2 export settings, pivot at the base centre) and referenced there. 50 are first-pass pieces that are only in the first-pass kits (vfx_<element>_kit.fbx, vfx_combo_kit.fbx); 4 are pass-2 pieces never exported: c2_poison_water_floatshadow, c2_water_earth_wetsand, v2_light_beam~spell.001, v2_light_castshadow~hit (the pass-2 notes call cast shadows a runtime effect).
